label: Names
description: Query name state, records, and subdomain information.

methods.name: getnameinfo
methods.description: Returns auction/ownership state for a name, including subdomain fields.

params.name: name
params.description: The Fistbump name to look up.

response.name: name
response.description: The name.

response.name: nameHash
response.description: SHA3-256 hash of the name (hex).

response.name: state
response.description: Auction state: INACTIVE, PENDING, OPENING, BIDDING, REVEAL, CLOSED, TRANSFER, or EXPIRED.

response.name: height
response.description: Height at which the current state began.

response.name: renewal
response.description: Height of the last renewal.

response.name: owner
response.description: Owner info: {hash, index, address, locked}. address and locked are present when the owner UTXO exists. Null if no owner.

response.name: value
response.description: Locked value in dollarydoos.

response.name: highest
response.description: Highest bid amount in dollarydoos.

response.name: restriction
response.description: Name restriction: "blacklisted", "ICANN reserved", or "premium". Omitted if unrestricted.

response.name: dnssecRequired
response.description: Whether DNSSEC proof is required to open/bid. Only present for restricted names.

response.name: parentIssue
response.description: Why a subdomain cannot be auctioned (parent not registered, blacklisted, or subdomains not enabled). Only present for INACTIVE subdomains with issues.

response.name: rolloutHeight
response.description: Block height when this name becomes available for auction. Only present for INACTIVE unrestricted TLD names.

response.name: auction
response.description: Auction timeline: {openEnd, biddingEnd, revealEnd}. Present for names that have been opened.

response.name: registered
response.description: Whether the name has been registered.

response.name: minimumBid
response.description: Minimum bid amount in dollarydoos at the current height.

response.name: auctionSubdomains
response.description: Whether on-chain subdomain auctions are enabled for this name.

response.name: parentHash
response.description: SHA3-256 hash of the parent name (hex). Only present for subdomains.

response.name: progress
response.description: Auction progress within the current stage (0.0 to 1.0).

response.name: currentStage
response.description: Current auction stage: OPENING, BIDDING, REVEAL, CLOSED, EXPIRED, TRANSFER, or REVOKED.

response.name: pendingAction
response.description: Covenant type of a pending mempool transaction for this name (e.g. OPEN, BID, REVEAL). Omitted if none.

response.name: canRegister
response.description: Whether this name can be registered right now (auction closed, not expired, not registered, has owner).

response.name: expirationHeight
response.description: Block height at which this name expires. Null for genesis-registered names that never expire.

methods.notes: Blacklisted names cannot be registered. Premium (≤6 bytes) and ICANN reserved names require DNSSEC proof to open/bid. Subdomain names include parentHash. PENDING state indicates a mempool operation exists but is not yet confirmed.

methods.name: resolveaddress
methods.description: Resolves a Fistbump name to a payment address. Tries the name's WALLET record, then the parent's SUB WALLET record for subdomains, then falls back to the on-chain owner address.

response.name: (result)
response.description: Bech32-encoded payment address.

methods.name: getnamebyhash
methods.description: Look up a name by its SHA3-256 hash.

response.name: (string | null)
response.description: The name string, or null if not found.

methods.name: getnameresource
methods.description: Returns DNS resource records for a name.

params.name: name
params.description: The Fistbump name to look up.

response.name: records
response.description: Array of DNS record objects (NS, DS, GLUE4, GLUE6, SYNTH4, SYNTH6, TXT). Returns null if name is not registered.

methods.name: getdnssecproof
methods.description: Get the TXT record needed to claim a premium name via DNSSEC.

response.name: record
response.description: The TXT record value to set (fbd=<name>:<address>).

response.name: subdomain
response.description: The subdomain to set the TXT record on (always "_fbd").

response.name: type
response.description: DNS record type (always "TXT").

methods.notes: Set a TXT record at _fbd.<your-domain> with the returned value, then use sendopen or sendbid with the domain parameter.

methods.name: verifydnssecproof
methods.description: Verify a DNSSEC proof for a premium name by querying DNS.

params.name: domain
params.description: The ICANN domain with the _fbd TXT record.

response.name: proof
response.description: Hex-encoded DNSSEC proof.

response.name: size
response.description: Proof size in bytes.

response.name: valid
response.description: Whether the proof is valid.

response.name: name
response.description: The name (only when valid).

response.name: domain
response.description: The domain (only when valid).

response.name: dnssecRequired
response.description: Whether DNSSEC is required for this name (only when valid).

response.name: bindingAddress
response.description: The address bound in the proof (only when valid).

response.name: message
response.description: Error message (only when invalid).

methods.notes: Queries DNS live to build and validate the proof. Use a resolver that supports DNSSEC (e.g. 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1).

methods.name: getnames
methods.description: List all names owned by the wallet.

response.name: value
response.description: Locked value in dollarydoos.

response.name: covenantType
response.description: Covenant type name (REGISTER, UPDATE, RENEW, etc.).

response.name: name
response.description: Name info: {hash, string, state, height, renewal}.

methods.name: getbids
methods.description: List bids placed by the wallet.

response.name: outpoint
response.description: Outpoint {hash, index} of the bid.

response.name: value
response.description: Actual bid value in dollarydoos.

response.name: lockup
response.description: Total lockup amount in dollarydoos.

response.name: height
response.description: Block height of the bid coin (0 if unconfirmed).

response.name: own
response.description: Whether the wallet still holds this bid UTXO.

response.name: revealed
response.description: Whether a REVEAL exists for this bid.

response.name: needsRepair
response.description: Whether the bid record is missing nonce/value data (use repairbid or importnonce to fix).

response.name: nonce
response.description: Bid nonce (hex). Zero hash if needs repair.

response.name: forfeited
response.description: Whether this bid's value is permanently lost (unrevealed in closed auction, or reveal stuck in expired name).

response.name: redeemed
response.description: Whether the bid has been redeemed (UTXO spent and not forfeited).

response.name: name
response.description: Name info: {hash, string, state, registered}.

response.name: canRegister
response.description: Whether this bid's name can be registered now.

response.name: registerDeadline
response.description: Block height of the registration deadline.

methods.name: repairbid
methods.description: Recover a lost bid record by deriving the nonce from the wallet's private key. Optionally brute-forces the bid value if not provided.

params.name: name
params.description: The name the bid is for.

params.name: value
params.description: Actual bid value in FBC. If omitted, the value is brute-forced.

response.name: repaired
response.description: Number of bid records repaired.

response.name: name
response.description: The name.

response.name: value
response.description: Recovered bid value in dollarydoos.

methods.notes: Wallet must be unlocked. Derives the nonce from the wallet's private key and the bid address. If value is omitted, tries multiple granularities (whole FBC, 0.01 FBC, etc.) up to the lockup amount.

methods.name: getauctions
methods.description: List auctions from the auction index. Requires --index-auction.

params.name: state
params.description: Filter by auction state: opening, bidding, reveal, or closed.

response.name: name
response.description: Name info: {hash, string, state}.

response.name: auction
response.description: Auction info: {height, openEnd, biddingEnd, revealEnd, bidCount, highestRevealed, highestLockup}.

methods.notes: Requires the auction index to be enabled (--index-auction).

methods.name: getauctionbids
methods.description: List all bids for a name from the auction index. Requires --index-auction.

params.name: name
params.description: The name to list bids for.

response.name: name
response.description: Name hash: {hash}.

response.name: txHash
response.description: Bid transaction hash.

response.name: outputIndex
response.description: Output index of the bid.

response.name: height
response.description: Block height of the bid.

response.name: lockup
response.description: Lockup amount in dollarydoos.

response.name: blindHash
response.description: Blind hash (hex).

response.name: address
response.description: Bidder address.

response.name: revealedValue
response.description: Revealed bid value in dollarydoos (only if revealed).

response.name: revealTxHash
response.description: Reveal transaction hash (only if revealed).

response.name: revealHeight
response.description: Block height of the reveal (only if revealed).

methods.notes: Requires the auction index to be enabled (--index-auction). Revealed fields are only present for bids that have been revealed.
